cases.name: pos-v4-jcs-chain-committed
cases.description: Format 4 plain JCS commits the chain block and a present empty array to capsule_id.

cases.name: neg-v3-format-version-unsupported
cases.description: format_version '3' is abandoned and must fail closed; format 4 is the only supported format.

cases.name: neg-v4-chain-tampered
cases.description: Changing a format-4 chain member after sealing causes capsule_id mismatch.

cases.name: neg-v4-canonicalization-missing
cases.description: Format 4 without canonicalization_id is a profile mismatch.

cases.name: neg-v4-canonicalization-jcs-n
cases.description: Format 4 explicitly declaring withdrawn jcs-n is rejected.

cases.name: neg-v4-canonicalization-non-string
cases.description: Format 4 declaring a non-string canonicalization identifier is rejected.

cases.name: neg-v2-canonicalization-absent
cases.description: Format 2 with absent canonicalization_id is abandoned and must fail closed; format 4 is the only supported format.

cases.name: neg-v2-canonicalization-null
cases.description: Format 2 with null canonicalization_id is abandoned and must fail closed; there is no vintage null-selection path.

cases.name: pos-executed-confirmed
cases.description: Clean executed capsule: confirmed effect (gate_executed), full identity, no verdict_class reason.

cases.name: pos-blocked
cases.description: blocked: a blocking constraint stopped it pre-dispatch; no effect, effect_mode not_applicable.

cases.name: pos-denied
cases.description: denied: operator/policy refused pre-dispatch; not_applicable.

cases.name: pos-hitl-dispatched
cases.description: hitl_dispatched: routed to a human, awaiting resolution; not_applicable, human_disposed false.

cases.name: pos-deferred
cases.description: deferred: a human postponed the decision; human_disposed true, not_applicable.

cases.name: pos-errored
cases.description: errored: action ran and threw, state unknown; effect dispatched -> dispatched_unconfirmed, attestation present.

cases.name: pos-timeout-pre-dispatch
cases.description: timeout before dispatch: no effect -> not_applicable (one timeout value covers both, per §5.4.2).

cases.name: pos-timeout-post-dispatch
cases.description: timeout after dispatch: effect dispatched -> dispatched_unconfirmed, attestation present.

cases.name: pos-confirmed-runtime-claimed
cases.description: confirmed -> effect_attestation REQUIRED (runtime_claimed variant).

cases.name: pos-dispatched-unconfirmed-required
cases.description: dispatched_unconfirmed -> effect_attestation REQUIRED (present).

cases.name: pos-not-applicable-absent
cases.description: not_applicable -> effect_attestation MUST be absent (no effect record).

cases.name: pos-planned-carve
cases.description: planned carve: effect.status planned -> not_applicable, effect_attestation absent; no digests.

cases.name: pos-failed-required
cases.description: failed -> dispatched_unconfirmed, effect_attestation REQUIRED (present). (§6 NOTE, conformant side.)

cases.name: pos-reverted-required
cases.description: reverted -> dispatched_unconfirmed, effect_attestation REQUIRED; underlying effect via external_ref.

cases.name: pos-unknown-effect-attestation
cases.description: unknown effect_attestation value: informational + graded no stronger than runtime_claimed; ok stays true.

cases.name: pos-unknown-verdict-class
cases.description: unknown verdict_class value: informational finding, ok stays true.

cases.name: pos-unknown-effect-type
cases.description: unknown effect.type value: informational finding, ok stays true.

cases.name: pos-supersedes-chain
cases.description: supersedes chain: a hitl_dispatched parent + a superseding resolution capsule; parent's open item is resolved.

cases.name: pos-concurrent-supersedes
cases.description: two supersedes over one parent: earliest in ledger order is authoritative; the later one surfaces an info finding; both remain ok.

cases.name: pos-cross-party-full-bilateral
cases.description: full_bilateral: initiator_ref + counterparty_ref + correlator all present, substantive result -> verifies clean.

cases.name: pos-cross-party-acknowledged-receipt
cases.description: acknowledged_receipt: initiator_ref + counterparty_ref + correlator present, bare receipt (no substantive result) -> verifies clean.

cases.name: pos-cross-party-unilateral-fallback
cases.description: unilateral_fallback: only initiator_ref present, no counterparty evidence -> verifies clean.

cases.name: neg-cross-party-overclaim
cases.description: the named overclaim case: full_bilateral claimed with only the initiator's signed half present (no counterparty_ref) -> assurance_overclaim (check 7, info severity, non-gating), derived.cross_party_rung downgraded to unilateral_fallback.

cases.name: pos-disposition-approver-counterparty
cases.description: disposition.approver='counterparty': a valid third member of the closed approver enum; human_disposed stays false, confirming the honesty invariant (human_disposed=true REQUIRES approver='human') still holds against the new value.

cases.name: neg-confirmed-without-response
cases.description: confirmed effect with NO response_digest -> confirmed-effect binding failure (check 3).

cases.name: neg-float-in-digest-field
cases.description: a JSON floating-point value in a digest-bearing field -> structural failure (check 1, §5.1).

cases.name: neg-unsafe-integer-in-digest-field
cases.description: an integer beyond 2^53-1 in a digest-bearing field -> structural failure (check 1); the current draft requires large integers to be decimal strings.

cases.name: neg-attestation-present-when-not-applicable
cases.description: planned (not_applicable) with effect_attestation present -> matrix failure (check 5).

cases.name: neg-attestation-missing-when-required
cases.description: failed (dispatched_unconfirmed) with effect_attestation absent -> matrix failure (check 5, the §6 NOTE).

cases.name: neg-never-dispatch-conflict
cases.description: never-dispatch verdict_class (blocked) with a dispatched effect (dispatched_unconfirmed) -> orthogonality failure (check 4).

cases.name: neg-capsule-id-mismatch
cases.description: a field mutated after sealing: capsule_id no longer recomputes over the canonical form (check 2).

cases.name: neg-chain-missing-parent
cases.description: a chain referencing a parent_capsule_id not present in the store -> chain failure (check 6).

cases.name: neg-approver-invalid
cases.description: disposition.approver outside the closed {human, policy} enum (neutral invalid token) -> structural failure (check 1, §5.4).

cases.name: honesty-dishonest-human-disposed
cases.description: human_disposed=true with a non-human (policy) approver in parsed bytes: §6 makes this a structurally-guaranteed invariant, so the verifier reports a NON-GATING defensive warning; ok still reflects the gating checks (here, true).

cases.name: neg-format-version-unknown
cases.description: format_version '1' is abandoned and must fail closed; format 4 is the only supported format.

cases.name: neg-never-dispatch-with-dispatched-effect
cases.description: blocked verdict_class (NEVER_DISPATCH §5.4.2) combined with effect.status='dispatched' → verdict/effect orthogonality failure (check 4).

cases.name: neg-never-dispatch-confirmed-no-response
cases.description: denied (NEVER_DISPATCH) with effect.status='confirmed' and no response_digest → both check 3 (confirmed-effect binding) and check 4 (verdict/effect conflict).

cases.name: canonical-array-preserved-not-sorted
cases.description: Array elements preserved in insertion order, not sorted (RFC 8785 S:3.2.2) under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-bool-and-deep-nesting
cases.description: Boolean true and deep object nesting: exercises bool branch and recursive dict serialization under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-integer-at-safe-max
cases.description: Integer at exactly Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = 9007199254740991 accepted (S:5.1 boundary) under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-integer-at-safe-min
cases.description: Integer at exactly -Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER = -9007199254740991 accepted (S:5.1 boundary) under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-integer-negative
cases.description: Negative integer -1 serialized as '-1' under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-integer-zero
cases.description: Integer 0 serialized as '0' (int branch in _jcs_value, S:5.1) under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-key-nfc-vs-nfd
cases.description: JCS does not normalize Unicode; NFD key A+U+030A (first unit 0x0041) sorts before B (0x0042) under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-key-sort-utf16-vs-codepoint
cases.description: UTF-16 key ordering: U+1F600 emoji (first surrogate 0xD83D) sorts after U+FF3A (single unit) under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-nested-member-named-capsule-id
cases.description: Top-level capsule_id/chain exclusion does not apply to nested members with those names under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-nested-member-named-chain
cases.description: Top-level capsule_id/chain exclusion does not apply to nested members with those names under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: canonical-string-escapes
cases.description: JCS mandatory escapes: \" \\ \b \t \n \f \r in a single string value (RFC 8785 S:3.2.2.2) under explicit format-4 plain JCS.

cases.name: reference-absent
cases.description: format 4 commits an absent references member as absent

cases.name: reference-bad-capsule-id
cases.description: AAC SHA-256 reference requires a Capsule ID

cases.name: reference-boolean-digest
cases.description: reference digest rejects boolean

cases.name: reference-duplicate-parent
cases.description: AAC SHA-256 reference must not duplicate the chain parent

cases.name: reference-empty
cases.description: format 4 commits a present empty references array

cases.name: reference-empty-algorithm
cases.description: reference digest algorithm is non-empty

cases.name: reference-empty-digest
cases.description: reference digest is non-empty

cases.name: reference-external-capsule
cases.description: valid external Capsule citation

cases.name: reference-future-extension
cases.description: reference extension members remain committed and open

cases.name: reference-future-purpose
cases.description: unknown citation purpose is informational

cases.name: reference-local-only-envelope-fields
cases.description: local Producer Envelope fields are excluded from format-4 Capsule ID

cases.name: reference-missing-type
cases.description: reference type is required

cases.name: reference-mixed-checks
cases.description: reference findings retain Class-1 check order

cases.name: reference-nonobject-reference
cases.description: each reference must be an object

cases.name: reference-nonstring-purpose
cases.description: citation purpose is a non-empty string

cases.name: reference-null-coordinates
cases.description: log coordinates must be an object

cases.name: reference-null-digest
cases.description: reference digest is a string

cases.name: reference-null-references
cases.description: format-4 references must be an array

cases.name: reference-object-references
cases.description: format-4 references rejects an object

cases.name: reference-opaque-proof
cases.description: Class 1 preserves opaque inclusion proof contents

cases.name: reference-partial-coordinates
cases.description: log coordinates requires all three members

cases.name: reference-same-hex-other-algorithm
cases.description: same digest under another algorithm is not the chain parent

cases.name: reference-same-hex-other-type
cases.description: same digest under another artifact type is not the chain parent

cases.name: reference-tampered-after-seal
cases.description: changing a format-4 reference after sealing causes Capsule ID mismatch

cases.name: reference-unknown-type-algorithm
cases.description: foreign digest contexts remain open

cases.name: reference-unregistered-capsule-token
cases.description: foreign artifact type remains open

cases.name: spec-derived-flat-payload-digest
cases.description: Format 4 commits a flat agent_input value with SHA-256(JCS(value)).

cases.name: spec-derived-nested-payload-digest
cases.description: Format 4 commits a nested agent_output value, including objects inside an array.

cases.name: spec-derived-unicode-payload-digest
cases.description: RFC 8785 string serialization preserves non-BMP and solidus characters while escaping U+0001.

cases.name: spec-derived-v4-chain
cases.description: Format 4 plain JCS commits the chain block to capsule_id.

cases.name: spec-derived-v4-null-empty-members
cases.description: Format 4 plain JCS commits present null, empty-array, and empty-object members.

cases.name: neg-v4-canonicalization-null
cases.description: Format 4 with canonicalization_id null fails closed.

cases.name: neg-v4-canonicalization-empty
cases.description: Format 4 with an empty canonicalization_id fails closed.

cases.name: pos-v05-spec-version-chain-committed
cases.description: pos-v4-jcs-chain-committed with only spec_version changed to -05: spec_version participates in capsule_id but selects no verification algorithm, so both verify.

cases.name: pos-v05-chain-follows
cases.description: -05 chain.relation 'follows' (the bare next-link) is a registered value.

cases.name: pos-v05-effect-inference-completion-host-served
cases.description: -05 effect.type 'inference_completion' with effect_attestation 'host_served_observed' (registered, runtime_claimed grade) and a response_digest.

cases.name: pos-v05-reference-counterparty-half
cases.description: -05 citation_purpose 'counterparty_half': a record holding a counterparty's half chains to its own head with 'follows' and cites the half by digest.

cases.name: pos-v05-reference-ran-under
cases.description: -05 citation_purpose 'ran_under': the Capsule cites, by digest, a record stating the runtime environment and authority its action executed under.
